desc.zh: 正職人才推薦、人力派遣與約聘、大量招募 RPO、薪資外包與勞健保實務。四種進人方式的差異、適用情境與計費方式一次看懂。
desc.en: Permanent placement, contract staffing, volume hiring and RPO, payroll and statutory outsourcing — how the four models differ, when to use each, and how they are priced.

title.zh: 四種進人方式，先選對再開始
title.en: Four hiring models — pick the right one first

sub.zh: 同樣是缺人，用獵才、派遣、RPO 或外包，成本結構、雇主責任與上線速度完全不同。這一頁先幫你分清楚。
sub.en: A vacancy can be filled by search, by dispatch, by RPO or by outsourcing — and the cost structure, employer liability and speed are nothing alike. This page sorts them out.

label.en: Talk it through with a consultant

body.zh: 適合關鍵職、主管職與市場上難找的專業職。以成功媒合計費，附保固期。
body.en: For key roles, leadership hires and scarce specialists. Success-based fee with a replacement guarantee.

bullets.zh: 主動接觸被動人選，不只等投遞
bullets.en: Direct approach to passive candidates, not just inbound applications
Consultant-led interviews with a written risk assessment

bullets.zh: offer 協商與反挽留處理

body.zh: 適合專案期、旺季、育嬰代理與人力凍結期。雇主責任與薪資作業由我們承擔。
body.en: For projects, peak seasons, parental cover and headcount freezes. Employer duties and payroll sit with us.

bullets.zh: 我方為雇主，負責投保與薪資
bullets.en: We are the employer of record for insurance and payroll

bullets.zh: 人力可依專案期間彈性增減

bullets.en: Conversion to permanent can be agreed up front

body.zh: 適合新廠開線、據點擴張與季節性進人，或整段招募流程外包。
body.en: For new lines, new sites, seasonal intakes — or handing over the hiring process end to end.

bullets.zh: 單案專案制或長期內嵌團隊
bullets.en: Project-based or an embedded long-term team

bullets.zh: 集體面談與到職作業一併處理
bullets.en: Group assessment days and onboarding handled together

bullets.zh: 每週回報進度與到缺率
bullets.en: Weekly reporting on progress and fill rate

body.zh: 適合沒有專職 HR、或想把重複性行政與法遵風險移出去的公司。
body.en: For companies without dedicated HR, or those moving repetitive admin and compliance risk off their plate.

bullets.zh: 薪資計算、加班費與請假扣減
bullets.en: Payroll runs, overtime and leave deductions

bullets.zh: 勞健保、勞退與二代健保申報
bullets.en: Labour and health insurance, pension and supplementary premium filings

bullets.zh: 薪資單發送與年度扣繳憑單
bullets.en: Payslip delivery and annual withholding statements

body.zh: 拿不定主意時，從「雇主責任要放在誰身上」開始想，通常最快。
body.en: When in doubt, start from where you want employer liability to sit. That question usually settles it.

rows.zh: 關鍵職、主管職、稀缺專業職
rows.en: Key, leadership and scarce specialist roles

rows.zh: 同時開出大量同質職缺
已有人，但行政與法遵吃不消
rows.en: You have the people; the admin is the problem

rows.zh: 你（人選直接受僱於貴公司）
rows.en: You — the hire joins your payroll

rows.zh: 成功媒合，依人選薪資比例
rows.en: Success fee, a share of the hire's salary

rows.zh: 依人數與作業範圍月費
數週至數月，視職缺稀缺度
rows.en: Weeks to months, depending on scarcity

rows.zh: 依批次規劃，可並行推進

rows.en: Live from the month after handover
Adjusted by contract if fill targets are missed

rows.zh: 服務範圍可分階段擴增

title.zh: 每一種服務背後，都接著顧問視角
title.en: Every service comes with the consulting view attached

body.zh: 我們在執行招募時看到的東西——薪資帶寬偏離市場、面試流程過長導致人選流失、職級混亂讓 offer 難談——都會回饋給你，而不是默默吞下去交差。這也是為什麼很多客戶最後把顧問案也交給我們。
body.en: Whatever we see while running your search — pay bands drifting from market, an interview process so long candidates drop out, grading so unclear that offers are hard to defend — we report back rather than quietly working around it. It is why many clients end up handing us the consulting work too.

label.zh: 了解 HR 顧問服務

items.zh: 「這個職級的薪資帶寬比市場低 15%，所以只收得到轉職動機不強的人選。」
items.en: "This band sits roughly 15% below market, so you are only attracting candidates without strong motivation to move."

items.zh: 「三關面試拉了六週，前兩位人選都在第五週接了別家。」
items.en: "Three interview rounds took six weeks; the first two candidates accepted elsewhere in week five."

items.zh: 「同樣的工作內容在你們公司有三個不同職稱，人選看不懂升遷路徑。」
items.en: "The same work carries three different titles here, so candidates cannot see a career path."

q.en: Can I use just one service?

a.zh: 可以。多數客戶從單一職缺的獵才開始，之後才視需要擴大到派遣或薪資外包。我們不做綁約式的整包銷售。
a.en: Yes. Most clients start with a single search and expand into contract staffing or payroll only if it makes sense later. We do not bundle services into a lock-in contract.

q.zh: 派遣人員可以轉為正職嗎？
q.en: Can a contract worker convert to permanent?

a.zh: 可以，轉正條件與費用建議在合約中先約定，避免日後爭議。實務上不少客戶會用派遣期間作為長期任用前的實際觀察。
a.en: Yes. Agree the conversion terms and any fee in the contract up front to avoid disputes. In practice many clients use the contract period as a real-world assessment before committing.

q.zh: 跨境職缺也是同一套流程嗎？
q.en: Do cross-border roles follow the same process?

a.zh: 流程相同，但當地的雇用形式、薪資結構與法規差異會在提案階段先說明。台灣的做法不能直接套到越南或馬來西亞的據點。
a.en: The process is the same, but local employment models, pay structures and regulations are set out at proposal stage. What works in Taiwan does not transfer unchanged to a site in Vietnam or Malaysia.

body.zh: 把情境講給我們聽，我們會建議最合適的做法——包括建議你先不要外包的情況。
body.en: Describe the situation and we will recommend the right model — including the cases where you should not outsource at all.
